summary: Impinj filed an 8-K disclosing privately-negotiated exchange agreements with certain holders of its 1.125% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027. The company will exchange roughly $56.5 million in cash plus about 188,451 shares, based on the Reference Price, for $56.3 million principal of the 2027 Notes; amounts adjust over a two-day measurement period ending September 14, 2026, with closings expected on or about September 16, 2026. Cash on hand funds the exchange, leaving about $1.0 million principal outstanding. Shares issued under Section 4(a)(2) to qualified institutional buyers; watch settlement share true-up and remaining note overhang.
